description: Belt of Faith Level 60 Father Inigo Montoy at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Belt of Faith if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Belt, 8 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 2 Arcane Crystals and 2 Mooncloth. Requirements: - Desecrated Belt - Wartorn Cloth Scrap x 8 - Arcane Crystal x 2 - Mooncloth x 2
name: Belt of Faith
